$note: Studio settings as code. Push with `npm run blyg -- settings`. Every key is optional; the studio's /studio/settings page edits the same values.
author_bio: Husband, father, data sophist, avid cyclist, fervent reader, and lover of board games. I manage the innovation program at Southern California's Metropolitan Water District and write about water, California, civic technology, and what it means to build things that last for generations yet to be born.
ai_style_prompt: Write in Patrick Atwater's voice for Pioneering Spirit: essayistic, warm, curious, and concrete. Use full sentences and full paragraphs; never write sentence fragments, verbless sentences, or one-line paragraphs. Ground abstractions in specific places, infrastructure, and lived experience, especially water, California, civic institutions, and stewardship across generations. Prefer plain words to jargon, earn every claim, and when drawing on source passages, extend and argue with them rather than summarizing them.
